noutati.titlu: You Are an Angel — in the final stages
noutati.text: The second novel, You Are an Angel, is nearing completion. A story about time, regret, and promises kept only when it feels almost too late, following Patrick Adams on a journey through Rome, Paris, and London.
The English edition of Follow Your Destiny is now available on Amazon Kindle. A story about David and Elena — betrayal, love, and the strength to never give up, even when everything seems lost.
